empty_reference_rule: sample_id and assembly_revision must both be null for gradient zero; nonzero gradients require both.
identity_rule: Physical entity IDs are immutable. Component replacement or rebuild increments assembly revision; technical repeats retain specimen identity.
retry_rule: Fresh attempt and record IDs, preserved predecessor receipt and reason. Never overwrite accepted or failed records.
derived_rule: Nonempty input_record_ids from immutable observed records; preserve software/method revision, units, coordinate convention and normalization denominator provenance.
transport_rule: Any changed station for an entity requires move receipt with matching origin/destination and unchanged entity set.
normalization_rule: Separate display normalization from raw or calibrated pressure; simulated maxima cannot establish measured absolute energy or efficiency.
replication_rule: Independent n counts distinct fabrication/allocation entities. Frequency views sharing a scan, pixels, angles and repeated pulses do not increase independent n.
gradient_rule: gradient_multiple_2pi_rad_per_m names the specimen design at gradient_reference_frequency_hz=3000. Actual frequency_hz is separate. Predictions require xi(f), and no flat dispersion default is supplied.
baseline_bootstrap: record_role=baseline requires observed empty guide, null sample/revision and null prior reference_id/reference_signature; current calibration and raw acquisition receipt still required. Its committed output may be registered as a later reference. specimen_measurement requires a compatible prior reference.
